  • Increased Privacy and Security: Schedule your shades to operate when you're not home, giving the impression that someone is always there. Automated shading systems provide peace of mind.

Hunter Douglas Limited Lifetime Warranty

Hunter Douglas offers one of the most robust warranties in the window treatment industry, covering various aspects of their products. This warranty ensures that your investment in quality window coverings is protected against defects and operational issues. For instance, the Hunter Douglas blinds and shades are known for their exceptional quality, which is backed by this commitment.

The warranty covers original defects in materials, workmanship, or failure to operate for the original residential purchaser. It includes internal mechanisms, cords, and components, and PowerView Motorization components are covered for five years. Hunter Douglas will repair or replace defective products or components, offering solutions for any issues that may arise. Exclusions typically include normal wear and tear, abuse, accidents, improper cleaning, and color fading due to sunlight.

Care and Maintenance Tips for Longevity

Proper care and maintenance are essential for preserving the beauty and functionality of your Hunter Douglas Shades. Following these simple guidelines will help ensure your window treatments remain in excellent condition for many years. Regular dusting with a feather duster, soft cloth, or vacuum with a brush attachment is recommended.

For stains, use a mild detergent and lukewarm water with a clean cloth, blotting carefully. Avoid harsh chemicals, as these can damage fabrics and finishes. Always refer to the product-specific care instructions and handle your shades gently to prevent damage to operating mechanisms. Keep shades dry and address any moisture exposure immediately to prevent mold or mildew growth.
